rationale: The English cue and Indonesian answer are sound, but Malaysian “vest” is not the best Malay learner answer. Standard Malay references give “rompi” for this garment and “ves” as an adapted form; “vest” is primarily an English spelling. The proposed contrast is therefore misleading, and no false-friend contrast is established.
